overview: Explore Uttarakhand with Safar Trails on a 9 nights / 10 days tour package. Discover Nainital’s lakes, Bhimtal’s scenic beauty, Ranikhet’s peaceful hills, Kausani’s Himalayan views, Chopta’s mountain trails, Auli’s landscapes and Jim Corbett’s wildlife. Ideal for families, friends and nature lovers seeking a memorable Himalayan getaway.

Itinerary Note: This is a suggested itinerary. The route and sightseeing sequence may change depending on travel dates, weather, road conditions, opening hours and local activity availability. The exact departure point and transfer arrangements should be confirmed before booking.

Preparation Note: Plan suitable clothing for changing mountain weather, carry essential personal medicines, keep some flexibility for road and weather changes, and confirm the operating status of optional activities before travelling.

itinerary.title: Kathgodam to Nainital – Begin Your Himalayan Holiday
itinerary.description: Meet your driver at Kathgodam Railway Station and transfer to Nainital. After arriving at your hotel, complete check-in and take time to relax after your journey. If time permits, spend the evening exploring Mall Road or enjoying the atmosphere around the town. Keep the first day relaxed so you can settle into your holiday.
itinerary.morningActivity: Meet driver at Kathgodam Railway Station and scenic uphill transfer to Nainital
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Hotel check-in and relaxation after your journey
itinerary.eveningActivity: Optional evening stroll along Mall Road and lakeside town exploration
itinerary.transfers: Station pickup and transfer to Nainital

itinerary.title: Nainital Local Sightseeing – Lakes and Mountain Views
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring Nainital's popular attractions. Visit Naini Lake, where you may enjoy boating if the service is available. Continue to Naina Devi Temple and Mall Road. You may also visit Snow View Point depending on local access and weather conditions. After sightseeing, return to your hotel and enjoy the evening at leisure.
itinerary.morningActivity: Visit Naini Lake with optional boating and explore sacred Naina Devi Temple
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Stroll along Mall Road and visit Snow View Point (weather permitting)
itinerary.eveningActivity: Return to hotel and enjoy a relaxed evening at leisure

itinerary.title: Nainital – Bhimtal – Sattal – Naukuchiatal – Ranikhet
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and begin your journey through Uttarakhand's scenic lake region. Visit Bhimtal Lake, followed by Sattal and Naukuchiatal. Enjoy the peaceful surroundings and take photographs during suitable stops along the route. Continue to Ranikhet and check in to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day relaxing after the drive.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast, check-out and excursion through Bhimtal, Sattal, and Naukuchiatal
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Scenic mountain drive towards Ranikhet with photography stops
itinerary.eveningActivity: Check-in at Ranikhet hotel and relax in the quiet mountain ambiance

itinerary.title: Ranikhet to Kausani – Scenic Mountain Roads
itinerary.description: Explore the surroundings of Ranikhet and visit Chaubatia Gardens if it is open and accessible on your travel date. Later, drive to Kausani through scenic mountain roads. On arrival, settle into your accommodation and enjoy the surrounding landscapes. If weather and visibility permit, take in the Himalayan views around sunset.
itinerary.morningActivity: Explore Ranikhet and visit Chaubatia Gardens (subject to accessibility)
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Scenic mountain drive to Kausani and check-in to accommodation
itinerary.eveningActivity: Witness panoramic Himalayan sunset views over snow peaks (weather permitting)

itinerary.title: Kausani Sightseeing – Viewpoints and Local Attractions
itinerary.description: Discover Kausani's peaceful atmosphere and mountain scenery. Visit Anasakti Ashram and Kausani Tea Estate, subject to opening hours. Explore local viewpoints and enjoy the views when the weather is clear. Keep the evening free for relaxation and time at your accommodation.
itinerary.morningActivity: Visit historic Anasakti Ashram and explore Kausani Tea Estate
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Discover scenic local viewpoints overlooking the Himalayan ranges
itinerary.eveningActivity: Evening at leisure for relaxation at your accommodation

itinerary.title: Kausani to Chopta – Into the Mountain Landscape
itinerary.description: After check-out, drive towards Chopta. Enjoy the changing scenery along the route, with scenic stops depending on available time and road conditions. On arrival, check in to your accommodation and relax. Enjoy the natural surroundings and prepare for the next day's mountain experience.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast, check-out and drive towards Chopta through alpine valleys
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Scenic stops along the route as you enter the high Garhwal Himalayas
itinerary.eveningActivity: Arrival and check-in at Chopta accommodation; rest in natural surroundings

itinerary.title: Chopta to Auli/Joshimath – Mountain Adventure and Scenic Travel
itinerary.description: Spend the morning enjoying the natural surroundings of Chopta. An optional Tungnath trek may be considered only if the trail is open and weather, fitness and local conditions permit. Afterwards, continue towards Joshimath or Auli. Travel time and routing may vary according to road conditions. Check in to your accommodation and enjoy the evening at leisure.
itinerary.morningActivity: Explore natural surroundings of Chopta (optional Tungnath trek, subject to trail/weather)
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Drive onwards to Joshimath or Auli according to mountain road conditions
itinerary.eveningActivity: Check in to accommodation and relax amidst magnificent mountain views
itinerary.stay: Hotel in Auli or Joshimath (as arranged)

itinerary.title: Auli Sightseeing – Panoramic Himalayan Scenery
itinerary.description: Explore Auli's mountain viewpoints and enjoy panoramic Himalayan scenery when visibility permits. An optional ropeway or cable car experience may be available, depending on operations, weather and ticket availability. Confirm the service before making plans around it. Spend the rest of the day relaxing and enjoying the mountain atmosphere.
itinerary.morningActivity: Explore Auli's viewpoints with panoramic views of Nanda Devi and Himalayan peaks
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Optional Auli ropeway or cable car experience (subject to operation and tickets)
itinerary.eveningActivity: Relax and soak in the crisp high-altitude mountain atmosphere
itinerary.stay: Hotel in Auli or Joshimath (as arranged)

itinerary.title: Auli to Jim Corbett – Journey Through Uttarakhand
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and begin the road journey towards the Jim Corbett area. This is a long transfer day, so an early start is recommended. On arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Keep the evening free after the journey.
itinerary.morningActivity: Early morning breakfast, check-out and long scenic drive down to the foothills
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Travel through scenic mountain valleys towards the Jim Corbett wilderness area
itinerary.eveningActivity: Check in to hotel in Jim Corbett area and unwind after the journey

itinerary.title: Jim Corbett – Optional Jungle Safari and Departure
itinerary.description: You may choose an optional jungle safari in the Jim Corbett area. Safari participation depends on advance permit booking, zone availability and the required reporting time. After the activity, transfer to your agreed departure point. Allow sufficient time for onward travel when planning your departure.
itinerary.morningActivity: Optional morning jungle safari in Jim Corbett (subject to advance permits & zone availability)
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Transfer to your agreed departure point for onward travel
itinerary.stay: Tour ends at agreed departure point

topPlacesToVisit.name: Nainital – Lakes, Temples and Local Markets
topPlacesToVisit.description: Nainital is the first destination of this Uttarakhand tour, offering lakeside scenery and popular local attractions. Places and activities: Visit Naini Lake, enjoy boating if available, explore Naina Devi Temple, walk along Mall Road, and visit Snow View Point when accessible and weather permits.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Bhimtal, Sattal and Naukuchiatal – The Kumaon Lake Region
topPlacesToVisit.description: Explore three scenic lake destinations while travelling from Nainital towards Ranikhet. Places and activities: Visit Bhimtal Lake, explore Sattal, stop at Naukuchiatal, and enjoy the natural scenery and photography opportunities.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Ranikhet – Gardens and Mountain Scenery
topPlacesToVisit.description: Ranikhet offers a quieter mountain atmosphere and scenic surroundings. Places and activities: Explore the local surroundings, visit Chaubatia Gardens if open and accessible, and enjoy scenic stops along the route.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Kausani – Himalayan Viewpoints and Tea Estate
topPlacesToVisit.description: Kausani is known for its mountain scenery and peaceful setting. Places and activities: Visit Anasakti Ashram, explore Kausani Tea Estate (subject to opening hours), visit local viewpoints, and enjoy Himalayan views when weather and visibility permit.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Chopta – Nature and Optional Trekking
topPlacesToVisit.description: Chopta is a key stop for travellers seeking mountain scenery and outdoor experiences. Places and activities: Enjoy the natural surroundings, take photographs at suitable scenic stops, and consider the optional Tungnath trek only when the trail and conditions allow.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Auli and Joshimath – Panoramic Mountain Views
topPlacesToVisit.description: Auli offers mountain viewpoints and opportunities to enjoy Himalayan scenery. Places and activities: Explore Auli's viewpoints, enjoy panoramic scenery when visibility permits, consider an optional ropeway or cable car if operating and tickets are available, and relax and explore the local surroundings.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Jim Corbett – Optional Wildlife Experience
topPlacesToVisit.description: The final destination provides an opportunity to unwind and consider a jungle safari. Places and activities: Stay in the Jim Corbett area, consider an optional jungle safari, and confirm safari zone availability, permits and reporting times in advance.

hotelsAndStays:
Accommodation: Hotel stays for 9 nights as per the confirmed itinerary.

• Nainital (Nights 1 & 2): Comfortable lakeside or hill resort in Nainital for town sightseeing and lake exploration.
• Ranikhet (Night 3): Quiet hill retreat in Ranikhet surrounded by pine forests and mountain views.
• Kausani (Nights 4 & 5): Scenic mountain resort in Kausani offering uninterrupted Himalayan peak views.
• Chopta (Night 6): Natural eco-resort or camp accommodation in the high-altitude meadows of Chopta.
• Auli / Joshimath (Nights 7 & 8): Mountain lodge in Auli or Joshimath convenient for viewpoint exploration and ropeway access.
• Jim Corbett (Night 9): Nature resort in the Corbett area ideal for relaxing and optional morning jungle safaris.

• Customisation Note: The final package price, hotel names, meal plan, vehicle category and included activities must be confirmed in the booking quotation.

faqs.question: How many days are required for this Uttarakhand tour?
faqs.answer: The Uttarakhand Complete Grand Tour is planned for 9 nights and 10 days, covering Nainital, Bhimtal, Ranikhet, Kausani, Chopta, Auli/Joshimath and the Jim Corbett area.

faqs.question: Where does the Uttarakhand tour package start?
faqs.answer: The supplied itinerary starts with a pickup from Kathgodam Railway Station. Travellers should confirm their arrival timing and the final transfer arrangements with Safar Trails.

faqs.question: Which destinations are covered in the package?
faqs.answer: The itinerary covers Kathgodam, Nainital, Bhimtal, Sattal, Naukuchiatal, Ranikhet, Kausani, Chopta, Auli or Joshimath, and the Jim Corbett area.

faqs.question: Is this Uttarakhand holiday package suitable for families?
faqs.answer: The package combines sightseeing, lake destinations, mountain viewpoints and leisure time. Families should discuss the ages, mobility needs and preferences of their travellers with Safar Trails, particularly when considering long road transfers or optional trekking.

faqs.question: Is the Tungnath trek included?
faqs.answer: The itinerary lists the Tungnath trek as optional. It should only be attempted if the trail is open and weather, fitness and local conditions permit. Confirm arrangements and any additional costs before departure.

faqs.question: Is the Auli ropeway included in the package?
faqs.answer: The ropeway or cable car is listed as optional and is subject to operation, weather and ticket availability. Confirm whether tickets are included in your quotation.

faqs.question: Does the package include a Jim Corbett jungle safari?
faqs.answer: The itinerary offers an optional safari on Day 10. Safari permits, zone availability, reporting times and charges must be checked in advance. Do not assume the safari is included unless it is stated in your booking confirmation.

faqs.question: What is included in the Uttarakhand tour package price?
faqs.answer: Inclusions depend on the final package quotation. Confirm the accommodation, transport, meal plan, sightseeing, driver charges, permits and entry tickets before making payment.

faqs.question: Can the Uttarakhand tour package be customised?
faqs.answer: Contact Safar Trails to discuss your travel dates, accommodation preferences and sightseeing requirements. Changes depend on route feasibility, availability and the final quotation.

faqs.question: What is the best way to prepare for this trip?
faqs.answer: Plan suitable clothing for changing mountain weather, carry essential personal medicines, keep some flexibility for road and weather changes, and confirm the operating status of optional activities before travelling.
